brief.name: mini_calc
brief.summary: A tiny statistics library used by the customer's reporting jobs.

items.title: mean([]) raises ZeroDivisionError
items.description:
Calling `calc.mean([])` crashes with ZeroDivisionError.
Expected: raise `ValueError('mean of empty list')`.
Repro: `python -c "import calc; calc.mean([])"`

files.tests/test_grader_bug01.py:
import pytest

from calc import mean


def test_empty_raises_value_error():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        mean([])


def test_regular_values():
    assert mean([2, 4]) == 3.0
    assert mean([5]) == 5.0
